messages:
rohan: Heads-up  opening a compact quickstart refresh PR: swap curl for a tiny SDK snippet, standardize env var names, and add a short migration note. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4401

kelly: nice. can you paste the node snippet here so i can check the auth usage?

rohan: yep, minimal example below:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', input: 'Hello Quickstart' });
console.log(out.text || out.output);
```

mike: looks good. please ensure docker, docker-compose, and serverless examples all use REDWOOD_API_KEY (folks copy-paste).

rohan: swapped `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere, updated the docker run line, and added a one-line note: "use secrets or env injection; do not commit keys."

kelly: can we include a 2-line migration hint for SDK3->SDK4? call out `client.setApiKey(...)` -> `new Redwood({ apiKey })` and link to /sdk/migrate.

rohan: added Migration Notes with that exact example and the link. also fixed a dead anchor under Auth Setup (was pointing to a removed heading).

ci-bot: ci:docs  lint + linkcheck passed for PR #4401 :white_check_mark:

mike: i will run the single-file quickstart locally (docker + cloud function) and approve if green. small nit: prefer `input` across snippets; i'll push a one-line normalization if needed.

rohan: thanks  will merge after mike's approval and CI. tagging ci-bot for staging publish.

ci-bot: publish:docs scheduled  staging will pick up change in ~9m after merge."
